gami-labs.name: Gami Labs
gami-labs.shortDescription: Gami Labs runs institutional-grade curated DeFi vaults with active on-chain curation and dynamic risk management (a professional 'risk curator'). Stellar is one of its largest deployments — roughly $19.7M of curated TVL on Stellar as of 2026-07-16 (DefiLlama) — alongside Ethereum, Base, Avalanche and Flare.

defindex.name: DeFindex
defindex.shortDescription: DeFindex (by PaltaLabs) is yield infrastructure on Stellar/Soroban. Non-custodial tokenized vaults let wallets, neobanks, and fintechs offer stablecoin savings: diversified yield strategies auto-rebalance USDC/EURC deposits across underlying protocols like Blend, abstracting lending and yield-vault primitives behind a single SDK and API.

sentora.name: Sentora
sentora.shortDescription: Sentora is the leading institutional DeFi platform providing curated vault infrastructure, risk management, and capital deployment tools for professional allocators. Non-custodial vaults with real-time analytics and $3B+ deployed across DeFi and real-world assets.

blend.name: Blend
blend.shortDescription: Blend is a lending and borrowing protocol (money market) on Stellar Soroban. Anyone can deploy permissionless, isolated lending pools where suppliers earn yield (interest/APY) by depositing assets like USDC, XLM and EURC, and borrowers take over-collateralized loans. It is the base lending and yield primitive other Stellar DeFi apps build on.

templar-protocol.name: Templar Protocol
templar-protocol.shortDescription: Templar is a decentralized 'cypher lending' protocol that lets Stellar users borrow USDC against XLM collateral directly from their Stellar wallets, without bridges or wrapped tokens. It uses NEAR's multi-party-computation (MPC) network and Chain Signatures to custody deposits and settle cross-chain. On Stellar the collateral asset is XLM; Bitcoin-collateral and Ethereum/NEAR markets exist on its other deployments. The Stellar integration was announced November 2025.

xoxno.name: XOXNO
xoxno.shortDescription: XOXNO is an enterprise-grade decentralized lending protocol built on Stellar's Soroban smart contract platform. It opens up advanced on-chain capital strategies to more market participants through a clean and intuitive UI/UX, with plans to integrate RWA markets. Core features include eMode-style capital efficiency optimizations for correlated assets, looping strategies, leveraged long/short exposure via native aggregator integrations, flash loans, isolated liquidity pools with independent risk profiles, NFT-based position management, and multi-source oracle protection. The team previously built and scaled the XOXNO DeFi platform on MultiversX since 2021, serving 100,000+ users and processing $40M in on-chain marketplace volume.
